faq.q: What is included in the Marbella sunset cruise with champagne and tapas?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, champagne (on request), light tapas, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA. You don't pay extra for the basics – just show up and enjoy.

faq.q: How much does a sunset cruise cost in Marbella?
faq.a: For 2 hours, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 cost €749 including everything. For a full 8-hour day, the same boats are €2,299. Larger yachts like the Mangusta 80 start at €4,719 for 4 hours and include a free jet ski.

faq.q: Which boats are available for sunset cruises?
faq.a: You can choose from the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 guests), Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 guests), or larger yachts like the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 guests) or Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 guests). All depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: Can I bring my own food and drinks?
faq.a: Yes, you're welcome to bring extra food or drinks, but our standard package already includes champagne, cava, beer, soft drinks, and tapas. If you have specific dietary needs, let us know in advance and we'll adjust the menu.

faq.q: What time do sunset cruises depart?
faq.a: Departure times vary by season. In summer (June–August), sunset is around 21:30, so we typically depart at 19:30 or 20:00. In spring and autumn, sunset is earlier. We'll confirm the exact time when you book.

faq.q: Is the sunset cruise suitable for children?
faq.a: Absolutely. Children are welcome on all our boats. The skipper will ensure a smooth ride, and life jackets for all ages are provided. The tapas and soft drinks are kid-friendly, and the sunset views are a treat for the whole family.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad?
faq.a: Safety comes first. If the forecast shows high winds or rough seas, we'll offer you a full refund or reschedule to another day. You won't lose your money – we'll work with you to find a suitable alternative.

faq.q: How do I book a sunset cruise with champagne and tapas?
faq.a: The easiest way is to send us a WhatsApp message with your preferred date, boat, and number of guests. We'll confirm availability and send you a booking link. A deposit is required to secure the date, with the balance due on the day.

data.body_html:
Watching the sun drop behind La Concha from the deck of a private boat, champagne in hand and tapas within reach – that's the Marbella sunset cruise experience. Departing from Puerto Banús, our sunset charters combine the Costa del Sol's golden hour with the relaxed luxury of a private skipper and a fully stocked bar. Prices start at €749 for two hours on an Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, with all drinks, snacks, fuel, and VAT included. No hidden extras, no surprises – just you, the sea, and the sky turning orange over the Mediterranean.

Why choose a sunset charter in Marbella?

Sunset is the best time to be on the water in Marbella. The heat of the day fades, the sea calms, and the light turns everything to gold. From Puerto Banús, you can cruise along the coast towards Cabopino or head west to Estepona, passing the Golden Mile and the Sierra Blanca foothills. A private skipper handles the navigation, so you can focus on the moment – and the champagne.

Unlike a crowded beach bar or a packed catamaran tour, a private sunset cruise gives you space, comfort, and flexibility. You set the pace, choose the route, and decide when to stop for a swim (if you're brave enough – the water's still warm in September). It's ideal for couples, small groups of friends, or a family celebration.

What's included in the champagne & tapas package?

Every sunset cruise from Puerto Banús includes the following, with no extra charges:

  • Licensed skipper (English and Spanish speaking)
  • Fuel for the entire charter
  • Champagne, cava, white wine, beer, and soft drinks
  • Tapas and light snacks – think olives, Iberian ham, cheese, and fresh bread
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) – always included in our quoted prices

If you have a special request – a birthday cake, a specific brand of champagne, or vegetarian tapas – just tell us when you book. We'll do our best to make it happen.

Which boats can you take for a sunset cruise?

We have a range of boats departing from Puerto Banús, so you can match the size to your group and budget. Here are the most popular choices for sunset trips:

For a more intimate experience, the Dubhe (8m, 5 guests) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 guests) are great options – perfect for a romantic evening. For larger groups, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 guests) includes a free jet ski, and the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 guests) offers serious space and luxury. Browse all our boats to see what fits.

Sample sunset cruise route from Puerto Banús

Here's a typical 2-hour sunset itinerary, though your skipper will adapt to sea conditions and your preferences:

  1. Departure (19:30): Leave Puerto Banús, head west along the coast.
  2. Golden Mile views: Pass the luxury villas of the Golden Mile and the iconic Marbella Club hotel.
  3. Anchoring at Cala del Faro: Drop anchor in a quiet cove for a swim and champagne toast.
  4. Sunset over La Concha: As the sun sets behind the mountain, enjoy tapas and cava on deck.
  5. Return (21:30): Cruise back to Puerto Banús as the lights of Marbella come on.

If you prefer a longer trip, consider a 4-hour charter that extends to Cabopino or even Estepona. See all our experiences for more ideas.

Best time of year for a sunset cruise

Marbella enjoys over 300 sunny days a year, so sunset cruises run almost year-round. The best months are May to October, when temperatures range from 22°C to 30°C and the sea is calm. In July and August, sunset is around 21:30, giving you long, warm evenings. In September and October, the light is softer and the crowds thinner – ideal for photography.

Even in winter, you can often sail in a light jacket and enjoy the dramatic skies. Just check the forecast with us – we'll advise on the best time and boat for the conditions.

How to book your Marbella sunset cruise

Booking is simple. Send us a WhatsApp message with your preferred date, boat, and group size. We'll confirm availability and send you a secure payment link for the deposit. The balance is due on the day of the cruise. For boats like the Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39, the price is fixed at €749 for 2 hours – no negotiation needed. For larger yachts, we'll provide a tailored quote within minutes.

Need help choosing? Contact us and we'll recommend the perfect boat for your group. And if you're planning a full day on the water, check out our day charter options for more ideas.
